author: aditsangani
summary: Add bounded FastAPI frame ingestion and software replay rehearsal
details: Separate liveness from enrollment/model/worker readiness; validate authenticated multipart metadata and actual JPEG bytes/dimensions against the accepted v1 contract; retain original capture lineage with bounded memory and atomic replay guards. Add an explicit loopback-only synthetic replay demonstration. Session issuance, inference, TLS deployment and device verification remain separate tasks. Ready for PM review, not Done.
validation: 19 backend tests and 39 shared repository/contract tests passed locally on Python 3.14.3. Real loopback HTTP replay returned health 200, readiness 503, upload 202 and duplicate 409. Backend suite runs explicitly per backend/README.md; existing shared CI does not install backend dependencies. No hardware or inference verification.
